question: Should the official memory-lancedb plugin grow built-in BM25 plus vector hybrid retrieval now, or should advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior stay external or ClawHub-owned?
rationale: The feature is source-verifiably missing and dependency-supported, but it changes official plugin retrieval semantics, adds config/default surface, and creates persistent index and fallback policy.

options.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
options.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

options.title: Keep advanced retrieval external
options.body: Leave official memory-lancedb vector-only and document advanced LanceDB hybrid/rerank behavior as an external plugin or ClawHub path.

options.title: Document vector-only scope
options.body: Close the direction only after documenting that memory-lancedb intentionally stays vector-only while memory-core and QMD own hybrid retrieval.

recommendation.title: Implement plugin-local hybrid search
recommendation.body: Add a memory-lancedb-owned hybrid mode with FTS index creation, explicit config/defaults, vector fallback behavior, docs, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from memory-lancedb maintenance, memory-core hybrid history, and prior review context on this issue.
